title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
abstract: arXiv:2610.29414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. translated_title: 在位置超级劫规则下求解围棋：可靠的证明迁移与新的棋盘价值
translated_abstract: 位置超级劫（PSK）规则禁止重现任何先前的全盘局面，它是中国规则以及计算机围棋所用规则的一部分。然而，几乎所有已被求解的围棋棋盘都是在更简单的基础劫规则下计算的。PSK 使求解变得困难：着法的合法性取决于整个对局历史，这破坏了使求解变得可行的三个关键工具，即置换表（图历史交互问题）、静态死活判断以及安全着法剪枝。我们提出了 Sanko，一个并行深度优先证明数求解器，它以可靠的方式恢复了这三个工具。其核心是一个低成本的证明迁移定理：一个已存储的证明在新路径上依然有效，除非该证明的获胜方必须形成的某个棋盘局面已经出现过。Sanko 使用六个线程在 16 分钟内完成了 5x5 围棋的求解证明，而之前的最先进方法需要六个进程运行 5.25 小时；在一台 192 线程的机器上，它仅需约一分半钟。它还建立了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了并行深度优先证明数求解器 Sanko，其核心证明迁移定理以可靠方式恢复了位置超级劫规则下被破坏的置换表、死活判断和着法剪枝三大工具，将 5x5 围棋的求解时间从 5.25 小时缩短至 16 分钟。
en_tdlr: Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver built on a cheap proof-transfer theorem, soundly restores transposition tables, life-and-death recognition, and move pruning under positional superko, proving 5x5 Go in 16 minutes versus the prior 5.25-hour state of the art.
